name: inventory with captures
claim: Enumerating a target's blobs by label with metadata and extracted captures can be built by extraction alone (docs/concepts/INVENTORY.md I1).

models.result: No model takes part: 42 of 42 app/*.js files inventoried by the js-acorn capture provider, 0 failed, 1747 symbol entries, 228-776 ms in node and 766-907 ms in the page; verdict promote; open: one label convention for built and read entries.

name: check records and has/has-not view
claim: Check records make what a session has and has not checked answerable from data alone, and are part of the flow state (docs/concepts/INVENTORY.md I3).

models.result: Held, checked and stale answered from session records with no turn text for 4 repo_read file reads (whole, slice, over-long, changed source); only repo_read's file op writes a check record, so verdict retest with a real model and the other read paths.

name: pluggable capture providers
claim: Any provider meeting the capture seam contract, one per language, can run from anywhere and supply symbol entries, edits and codegen (docs/concepts/INVENTORY.md QI6, QI8).

models.result: The seam exists in app/inventory.js (register, capture) with one JavaScript provider (app/capture-js.js, acorn 8.19.0 vendored) and a second language registered in the suite; op capture only, edit and generate are not built, reference edges and annotations are empty.
